title.target: biérén de lù yě huídào zhèlǐ
title.english: Other Roads Lead Back Here Too

pairs.target: cìrì shàngwǔ , tǎ wéi chéngchē huídào bái jiē . tā zài jìxìn chù wèn guò wū yà de huíxìn , réng méiyǒu , biàn jiāng jì qù de rìqī jì zài zìjǐ de zhǐbiān , cái qù qǐnshì .
pairs.english: The next morning Tavi rode back to White Steps. There was still no reply from Wuya at the mail office; he noted his sending date before going to the dormitory.
pairs.hanzi: 次日上午，塔维乘车回到白阶。他在寄信处问过乌娅的回信，仍没有，便将寄去的日期记在自己的纸边，才去寝室。

pairs.target: pà wò zài tǎ wéi tuī mén yǐqián , xiān ràng láng jiào le yìshēng .
pairs.english: Before Tavi pushed the door open, Pavo made the wolf howl.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃在塔维推门以前，先让狼叫了一声。

pairs.target: nà shēngyīn xiàng liǎngkuài méi cā gānjìng de mùtou jiá zhe yìzhī pòwǎn , tǎ wéi xià dé bāo dài yì huá , zhèngyào wǎng pángbiān duǒ , biàn tīngjiàn lǐmiàn yǒurén xiào .
pairs.english: It sounded like two dirty wooden blocks squeezing a cracked bowl. Startled, Tavi let his strap slip and was about to dodge when laughter came from inside.
pairs.hanzi: 那声音像两块没擦干净的木头夹着一只破碗，塔维吓得包带一滑，正要往旁边躲，便听见里面有人笑。

pairs.target: pà wò jiàngmén lākāi , shǒulǐ tí zhe nà zhī zuǐ wāi de yǐng jià , shuō zhèhuí zǒngsuàn bú xiàng lòuqì le , jiào tā zài jìn yícì , zìjǐ hǎokàn nǎlǐ gāi dòng .
pairs.english: Pavo opened the door holding the crooked-jawed shadow frame. At least it no longer sounded like leaking air; Tavi should enter again so he could see what needed adjustment.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃将门拉开，手里提着那只嘴歪的影架，说这回总算不像漏气了，叫他再进一次，自己好看哪里该动。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhàn zài ménwài méi nuó , xiān jiāng gěi tā de báo mù hé yìng xiàn dìguòqù , shuō ruò zài jiào , zìjǐ jiù náhuíqù .
pairs.english: Tavi stayed outside and handed over the wood and stiff wire, threatening to take them back if it howled again.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维站在门外没挪，先将给他的薄木和硬线递过去，说若再叫，自己就拿回去。

pairs.target: pà wò jiēguò , méi lìkè shìzhuāng , fǎndǎo bǎ tā bāo zhuài jìnwū , cháo nà zhāng réng liú zhe de chuáng yì tuī , shuō chuáng méi gěi tā zhàn , chuángbiān de huī kěshì tì tā liú quán le .
pairs.english: Pavo took them without fitting them yet, pulled the pack inside, and pushed it toward Tavi's waiting bed. He had not occupied it, but had saved all the dust for him.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃接过，没立刻试装，反倒把他包拽进屋，朝那张仍留着的床一推，说床没给他占，床边的灰可是替他留全了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi bǎ bèi jiǎo xiānkāi , xiàn tǒng guǒrán yòu zài zhuōxià .
pairs.english: Tavi lifted the blanket corner. Sure enough the thread spool was under the table again.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维把被角掀开，线筒果然又在桌下。

pairs.target: tā yòng jiǎo qīngqīng bōchūlái , xiǎngdào pà wò zhēn méi ná tā gěi láng ān yǎnjīng , xīnlǐ nà diǎn méi shuō chūlái de xiè , biàn zhī shuō chéng le jiè tā bǎ sàozhou .
pairs.english: He nudged it out with a foot. Thinking Pavo really had not used it for the wolf's eyes, his unspoken gratitude emerged only as a request for a broom.
pairs.hanzi: 他用脚轻轻拨出来，想到帕沃真没拿它给狼安眼睛，心里那点没说出来的谢，便只说成了借他把扫帚。

pairs.target: wǔhòu tāmen qù xī jiē , mǐlā yǐjīng zuòzài táishàng chāi yìzhī kōng guàn .
pairs.english: That afternoon they went to the West Steps, where Mira was already sitting on a step undoing an empty jar.
pairs.hanzi: 午后他们去西阶，米拉已经坐在台上拆一只空罐。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yìyǎn rènchū guàn kǒu de cǎoshéng , wèn suān guǒ shìbushì quán gěi tā chī le .
pairs.english: Tavi recognized the straw cord at once and asked if she had eaten all the sour fruit.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维一眼认出罐口的草绳，问酸果是不是全给她吃了。

pairs.target: mǐlā táiqǐ tóu , xiān xiào le yíxià , yòu zhòuméi , shuō tā chàbùduō yígèyuè méi jiàn , dìyījù jiù pánwèn shuí tōuchī , zhēnshì zhǎngjìn .
pairs.english: Mira looked up, smiled then frowned: nearly a month apart and his first words interrogated who had stolen food. Such progress.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉抬起头，先笑了一下，又皱眉，说他差不多一个月没见，第一句就盘问谁偷吃，真是长进。

pairs.target: yīwén cóng bèihòu duān lái sānwǎn liángchá , shuō guǒzǐ shì zìjǐ chī de , guànzǐ zuórì jiègěi mǐlā zhuāng dīng , jīntiān lái tǎo .
pairs.english: Iven brought three bowls of cool tea from behind. He had eaten the fruit; Mira borrowed the jar for nails yesterday, and he wanted it back today.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文从背后端来三碗凉茶，说果子是自己吃的，罐子昨日借给米拉装钉，今天来讨。

pairs.target: mǐlā huàng le huàng guàn dǐ , lǐmiàn zhī shèng liǎngméi wān dīng , wèn tā yào buyào lián zhèdiǎn lìxī yě dàihuíqù .
pairs.english: Mira shook the jar's bottom, with just two bent nails left, asking if he wanted this interest too.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉晃了晃罐底，里面只剩两枚弯钉，问他要不要连这点利息也带回去。

pairs.target: tā shuō búyào dīng , yào nàgēn néng sōngkāi de hǎo shéng , tǎ wéi zài pángbiān shuō shéng shì zhǎngguì bǎng de , bié yòu gěi cuò rén fā jiǎngzhuàng .
pairs.english: He wanted the good releasable cord, not nails. Tavi said the innkeeper had tied it, so no awarding prizes to the wrong person again.
pairs.hanzi: 他说不要钉，要那根能松开的好绳，塔维在旁边说绳是掌柜绑的，别又给错人发奖状。

pairs.target: sāngè rén dōu xiào le . mǐlā bǎ guànzǐ fàngxià , gěi tā ràngchū zhōngjiān nà diǎn wèizhì , zuò dé tóng dìyīcì jǐ wàng jìng shí chābùduō , xītóu jīhū pèngdào yìqǐ .
pairs.english: All three laughed. Mira set the jar down and made space between them, knees nearly touching as when they first crowded round the telescope.
pairs.hanzi: 三个人都笑了。米拉把罐子放下，给他让出中间那点位置，坐得同第一次挤望镜时差不多，膝头几乎碰到一起。

pairs.target: yīwén hái tèyì jiāng zìjǐ de yījiǎo lākāi , shuō jīnrì méiyǒu yìzhāng xiě bù quán de qiáo tú , shuí yě bié jiègù wǎng zìjǐ shēnshàng mǒ yóu .
pairs.english: Iven carefully pulled his coat aside: no incomplete bridge diagram today, so nobody had an excuse to wipe grease on him.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文还特意将自己的衣角拉开，说今日没有一张写不全的桥图，谁也别借故往自己身上抹油。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tāochū kǎo dòu , zhǐ yì zhǎnkāi , mǐlā jiù xiānzhuā le yìbǎ .
pairs.english: Tavi brought out roasted beans, and Mira took a handful as soon as the paper opened.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维掏出烤豆，纸一展开，米拉就先抓了一把。

pairs.target: tā kànjiàn tā zhǐtou cèbiān liǎngdào qiǎn huà , wèn zěnme lái de .
pairs.english: He saw two shallow scratches on her finger's side and asked their cause.
pairs.hanzi: 他看见她指头侧边两道浅划，问怎么来的。

pairs.target: tā shuō xiāo yàngjiàn , dìyīdāo méi huài , dìèrdāo wèile xiū dé hǎokàn , fǎndǎo guā dàoshǒu , jiào tā bié qù gǔ jì nàlǐ wèn , duìfāng yǐjīng ná zhè shì xiào guò hǎojǐhuí .
pairs.english: She had been trimming a prototype. The first cut was fine, the second neatening cut caught her hand; don't ask Guji, who had laughed about it several times already.
pairs.hanzi: 她说削样件，第一刀没坏，第二刀为了修得好看，反倒刮到手，叫他别去谷霁那里问，对方已经拿这事笑过好几回。

pairs.target: tā de yè shāi yǒu yíhù yuànyì shìyòng , děng hé kàn huíqù , xiān tóng sū yǐ jiāng chōuqǐ shí dǎng shuǐ de xiǎo piàn gǎi hǎo , zài yuē rén qù kàn , búshì xiànzài yǐjīng huàn le shuíjiā de jìnshuǐkǒu .
pairs.english: A household wanted to try her leaf screen. After review she and Suyi would improve its splash guard, then arrange a visit; no existing intake had been replaced yet.
pairs.hanzi: 她的叶筛有一户愿意试用，等核看回去，先同苏苡将抽起时挡水的小片改好，再约人去看，不是现在已经换了谁家的进水口。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wèn dà ní hé hái zuò bu zuò , tā jiáo zhe dòu , méi xiàng cóngqián nàyàng lìkè dá néng .
pairs.english: Tavi asked about the large silt box. Chewing beans, she did not answer yes immediately as before.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维问大泥盒还做不做，她嚼着豆，没像从前那样立刻答能。

pairs.target: " zuò . " tā zuìhòu shuō , " kě wǒ yě xiǎng zuò diǎn biéde . bùnéng yǐhòu shuíjiā de shāi dǔ le , jiù shuō nà shì mǐlā zuì huì gāndeshì . "
pairs.english: “Yes,” she finally said. “But I want other work too. Every blocked screen can't become what Mira does best.”
pairs.hanzi: “做。”她最后说，“可我也想做点别的。不能以后谁家的筛堵了，就说那是米拉最会干的事。”

pairs.target: yīwén diǎntóu diǎn dé hěnkuài . mǐlā zhuǎnxiàng tā , wèn shìbushì yòu yǒurén jiāng tā dàngchéng huì tì fùqīn dì huà de háizi .
pairs.english: Iven nodded rapidly. Mira turned to ask if someone had again treated him as a child carrying messages for his father.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文点头点得很快。米拉转向他，问是不是又有人将他当成会替父亲递话的孩子。

pairs.target: tā duān zhe wǎn tíng le yíxià , shuō wǔfàn yǒurén yuē , quèshí shì fùqīn jièshào de , dàn zìjǐ yǐjīng tóng shī nán wènqīng , míngrì zhī qù jiàn rén , bú tì nǎ yìfāng dāying bǎ jiāojiē de zhǐ gǎi gè zì .
pairs.english: He paused over his bowl: there was a lunch invitation through his father, but he had checked with Shinan. Tomorrow was only a meeting, no promising either side a changed word in the handover papers.
pairs.hanzi: 他端着碗停了一下，说午饭有人约，确实是父亲介绍的，但自己已经同施南问清，明日只去见人，不替哪一方答应把交接的纸改个字。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tīng zhe , hūrán juéde liǎnggè rén míngmíng réng zuòzài shēnbiān , shēnhòu què gè yǒu yìtiáo zìjǐ méi zǒuguò de lù .
pairs.english: Listening, Tavi suddenly felt that though both sat beside him, each had a road behind them he had never traveled.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维听着，忽然觉得两个人明明仍坐在身边，身后却各有一条自己没走过的路。

pairs.target: tā jiāng xīn chǐ ná chūlái , cái zhǎnkāi , mǐlā biàn shēnshǒu , yīwén yě còujìn , shuō zhè dōngxī ruò zǎo yǒu , tǎ wéi jì lái de jiù hú yě búzhìyú zhī xiě " dà dé bùdéliǎo ".
pairs.english: He unfolded the new ruler. Mira reached and Iven leaned close: with this earlier, Tavi's arch letters might have said more than “unbelievably huge.”
pairs.hanzi: 他将新尺拿出来，才展开，米拉便伸手，伊文也凑近，说这东西若早有，塔维寄来的旧弧也不至于只写“大得不得了”。

pairs.target: tā xiào zhe qǔchū tú , gěi tāmen kàn xīn bǔ de chǐcùn , yě bǎ méi duì shàng de xiàn tānkāi .
pairs.english: Smiling, he showed them added dimensions and spread out the unmatched line too.
pairs.hanzi: 他笑着取出图，给他们看新补的尺寸，也把没对上的线摊开。

pairs.target: mǐlā wèn nà yì gé wèishénme kōng zhe , tā shuō nàlǐ yǒu yídào biān , zìjǐ méi kàn míngbái , ná huílái xiǎng wèn lǎoshī .
pairs.english: Mira asked about the blank square. He said an edge there had puzzled him, so he had brought it for the teachers.
pairs.hanzi: 米拉问那一格为什么空着，他说那里有一道边，自己没看明白，拿回来想问老师。

pairs.target: tā dītóu kàn le bàntiān , shuō gé zhème yuǎn , zìjǐ yě kàn bù míngbái , děng tā wèn guò , bié zhī huí yíjù hòulái míngbái le .
pairs.english: She studied it, saying she could not understand from so far away either. After asking, he must not merely write back that he understood now.
pairs.hanzi: 她低头看了半天，说隔这么远，自己也看不明白，等他问过，别只回一句后来明白了。

pairs.target: yīwén bǎ zìjǐ de hé kàn zhǐ ná chūlái , tā pái zài míngrì xiàwǔ , mǐlā hòu rì , sāngè rén dōu búshì huílái jiù yòu zhù zú yígè xuéqī .
pairs.english: Iven showed his review paper: tomorrow afternoon for him, the day after for Mira. None had returned for a whole new term's residence.
pairs.hanzi: 伊文把自己的核看纸拿出来，他排在明日下午，米拉后日，三个人都不是回来就又住足一个学期。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō zìjǐ míngzǎo hé kàn , ruò méi tuō wǎn , qù běi gōngfáng jiàn nài lěi , hái xiǎng tóng tā wèn yíduàn néng cóng zìjǐ jiǎoxià kāishǐ de lù .
pairs.english: Tavi's review was tomorrow morning; unless late, he would see Nerai at the north workshop and ask about a road beginning beneath his own feet.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说自己明早核看，若没拖晚，去北工房见奈蕾，还想同她问一段能从自己脚下开始的路。

pairs.target: liǎnggè rén dōu méi xiào tā . mǐlā xiān wèn tā yào qù nǎ yìbiān , yīwén què wèn néng bunéng xiān dàihuí yìdiǎn suān dé bú nàme hěn de guǒ .
pairs.english: Neither laughed. Mira asked which way he wanted to go, while Iven asked for fruit that was a little less brutally sour.
pairs.hanzi: 两个人都没笑他。米拉先问他要去哪一边，伊文却问能不能先带回一点酸得不那么狠的果。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shuō zhè yíguàn yǐjīng cháng guò , yīwén shuō zhīdào , suǒyǐ zhèhuí guài de shì tā , búshì zìjǐ de shétou .
pairs.english: Tavi said he had tasted that jar's fruit. Iven knew, so this time he blamed Tavi, not his own tongue.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维说这一罐已经尝过，伊文说知道，所以这回怪的是他，不是自己的舌头。

pairs.target: bàngwǎn pà wò zhēn bǎ láng jià nádào xiǎoyuàn . yuànlǐ jǐgè háizi běnlái zhī xiǎng kàn tā jiào , jiéguǒ zuǐ yìzhāng , bànbiān xiān luòxiàlái , láng xiàng tōuchī shí hūrán yáténg , háizi men yíxià xiào dǎo .
pairs.english: That evening Pavo brought the wolf frame to the little yard. The children wanted a howl, but half its mouth dropped first, like a thief struck by toothache, and they collapsed laughing.
pairs.hanzi: 傍晚帕沃真把狼架拿到小院。院里几个孩子本来只想看它叫，结果嘴一张，半边先落下来，狼像偷吃时忽然牙疼，孩子们一下笑倒。

pairs.target: pà wò méi jí zhe duǒ dào bù hòu xiū , fǎnér ràng láng yòng zhuǎzi dǎngzhù zuǐ , yuè dǎng yuè wāi , lián pángbiān zhèng shōu yīfu de rén yě tíngzhù le .
pairs.english: Instead of hiding behind the cloth to repair it, Pavo made the wolf cover its mouth with a paw, growing ever more crooked, until even people gathering laundry stopped.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃没急着躲到布后修，反而让狼用爪子挡住嘴，越挡越歪，连旁边正收衣服的人也停住了。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zuòzài láng xià , mǐlā ná tā de xīn chǐ bǐ zhe láng zuǐ de jiǎo , yīwén hù zhe nà zhī zhōngyú xǐ gānjìng de kōng guàn .
pairs.english: Tavi sat under the gallery, Mira gauging the wolf jaw's angle with his new ruler and Iven guarding the finally clean empty jar.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维坐在廊下，米拉拿他的新尺比着狼嘴的角，伊文护着那只终于洗干净的空罐。

pairs.target: shuí dōu méi xiān wèn míngrì huì buhuì kǎo bùhǎo .
pairs.english: Nobody first asked whether tomorrow's assessment would go badly.
pairs.hanzi: 谁都没先问明日会不会考不好。

pairs.target: tā tīngjiàn shúxī de zhōngxiǎng , méiyǒu lìkè zhàn qǐlái , děng pà wò bǎ nà shēng pòwǎn yíyàng de jiào yòu yǎn le yíbiàn , cái gēnzhe liǎnggè rén yìqí xiào chū shēng .
pairs.english: He heard the familiar bell without immediately rising, waiting for Pavo to repeat the cracked-bowl howl before laughing aloud with the other two.
pairs.hanzi: 他听见熟悉的钟响，没有立刻站起来，等帕沃把那声破碗一样的叫又演了一遍，才跟着两个人一齐笑出声。
